title: Move the power shape
summary: Move every played position by two frets.

steps.title: Move the power shape
steps.body:
Move the G5 positions two frets higher to make A5, an A power chord. Use string 6 fret 5, string 5 fret 7 and string 4 fret 7; the notes become A, E and a higher A. Move all three positions together.

**Why it matters:** A shape with no open strings can move along the neck while keeping the same distances.

steps.title: Read the positions
steps.body: Read the actual fret numbers 5, 7 and 7. A2 at string 6 fret 5 supplies the new root. The gap from A to E is still a perfect 5th. Leave the other three strings out.

items.prompt: Play A and E together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Make it comfortable
steps.body: Clear the selection with Escape before changing from G5 to A5. Move slowly and keep the spaces between the positions. A comfortable hand matters more than speed.

Play A and E together. Use any positions for these notes.
